name: DAVIS 2017: Densely Annotated Video Segmentation
description: DAVIS 2017 (Densely Annotated VIdeo Segmentation) is the standard benchmark for multi-object video segmentation. Extending the original single-object DAVIS 2016 dataset, DAVIS 2017 features 150 high-definition video sequences comprising 10,459 frames with pixel-accurate per-frame segmentation masks for 376 distinct object instances. It benchmarks semi-supervised (one-shot initialization) and unsupervised video object segmentation.
